observations.behavior: Adds a new parameter `take_over_as_creator` to the Vision Scanners API and its MCP tool, and a new dialog and consent flow in the frontend.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows a user to become the creator of a scanner when the original creator no longer has access, enabling scheduled scans to run as the caller. This is a capability improvement for account recovery and access delegation.
